title: Points Reversal on a Refunded Grooming Pass — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Ledger Rule and Tool
content:
## Ledger rule

Under **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, when a grooming pass that earned points is cancelled and its unused visits are refunded, a care agent books the points reversal of the pass purchase, dated on the refund date and tied to the pass.

The reversal is one points-reversal entry on the rewards ledger: dated on the refund date, tied to the original pass purchase record, carrying the refunded spend and the points taken back, and lowering the points balance by those points.

## Booking tool: `reverse_refund_points_2db3868c`

**Capability.** Takes back Pals Rewards points that a purchase earned after that purchase was refunded. One call books one points-reversal entry on the rewards ledger, dated on the refund date and tied to the original purchase record, carrying the refunded spend and the points taken back, and lowers the points balance by those points. The customer then sees the reversal in the points history and the lower balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the customer's Pals Rewards membership, read from the membership lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `source_category` | the program of the refunded purchase: `autoship` (a charged Autoship shipment), `rx` (a pharmacy fill), `groom` (a salon pass purchase, club fee or salon checkout), `order` (a retail order line), `train` (a training enrollment), `vet` (a wellness plan payment), `livepet` (a live animal purchase), `none` (not tied to a purchase in any program) | one of the listed values |
| `source_event_id` | the reference number of the original purchase record that earned the points, read from that program's history lookup | identifier |
| `refund_date` | the date the purchase was refunded, copied from the refund record; it becomes the date of the reversal entry | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `refunded_spend_usd` | the refunded part of the purchase's qualifying spend | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `points` | the points to take back | whole non-negative integer |

**Return.** On success: status `reversed`, the `member_event_id` of the reversal entry, the `points` taken back, the `refunded_spend_usd` and the `points_balance` after the reversal.
